name: Minnesota
agency: Minnesota Department of Public Safety, Driver and Vehicle Services (DVS)
permitAge: 15 (instruction permit, valid 2 years). Under 18: 30 hours of driver education classroom done and enrolled in behind-the-wheel (or first 15 classroom hours of a concurrent course), plus a parent's signature (manual p13)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours including 15 at night, or 40 hours including 15 at night if a parent completes the parent class from an approved driver education program (manual p14)
teen.holdPermit: 6 months, with no convictions for moving or alcohol/controlled-substance violations (manual p13-14); 3 months for new drivers 19 or older
teen.nightLimit: Provisional license, first 6 months: no driving midnight to 5 a.m. unless with a licensed driver 25 or older, driving between home and work, home and a school event without school transport, or for employment (manual p14)
teen.passengerLimit: Provisional license: first 6 months at most one passenger under 20; second 6 months at most three under 20; no limit when a parent or guardian is along; immediate family members under 20 do not count (manual p15)
teen.phone: Instruction permit and provisional license holders under 18: no cell phone use while driving, hand-held or hands-free, except 911 (manual p13, p14, p79). All drivers: no holding a phone while driving; calls only in voice-activated or hands-free mode; no texting, email or internet (manual p40; Minn. Stat. 169.475).

bac.under21: any detectable amount (no-tolerance / Not a Drop law; manual p15, p95)

notes: Handbook: Minnesota Driver's Manual, June 2026 (PDF created 2026-05-29), read in full 2026-10-09. Printed page = PDF page minus 3.

Knowledge test (manual p10): multiple choice and true/false, on paper or computer, one test per day, 80 percent to pass; $10 fee from the third attempt after two failures. The number of questions is not stated in the manual or on the DVS pages checked, so questions/pass stay null.

Test languages (DVS Class D new-driver pages, 2026-10-09): English, ASL, Somali, Hmong, Russian, Vietnamese, Karen and Spanish; other languages by appointment as a verbal exam with the applicant's own licensed interpreter. Manual also in Dari, Hmong, Karen, Pashto, Russian, Somali, Spanish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese.
Permit supervisor: 21 or older for drivers under 18, 18 or older for adults, in the front passenger seat (manual p13-14).
Full under-21 license: at 18, or after 12 months on a provisional license with no alcohol, drug or crash-related violations and at most one other moving violation (manual p16).

Move Over law (manual p44): move to the lane farthest from a stopped emergency vehicle with flashing lights when safe, else slow down; also stalled or disabled vehicles and service, maintenance, utility, construction, postal and garbage vehicles with warning lights.

School bus (manual p1, p41-42): stop at least 20 feet away when red lights flash, even if the stop arm is not out; no stop needed on a divided roadway when the bus is on the other side (Minn. Stat. 169.444 subd. 4: physical barrier, raised or depressed median).

Speed (manual p26): 10 mph alleys, 30 mph urban or town roads, 55 mph elsewhere. Interstates 70 mph outside / 65 mph inside urbanized areas over 50,000 come from Minn. Stat. 169.14 subd. 2 (not in the manual).
Headlights (manual p23): sunset to sunrise, and in rain, snow, hail, sleet, fog or when you cannot see 500 feet ahead.
Insurance: owners must carry no-fault and liability insurance (manual p40); minimum liability 30/60/10 per Minn. Stat. 65B.49 subd. 3 (not in the manual).
